selection_policy: Explicit F600-F2 train-only; disjoint from S600-common-400 families/snapshots/instances; normalize eligible only.

mechanism_evidence.contract: Context.meta returns the shared live mapping; repeated accesses are identical (is), mutations through one reference are visible through the original and other references, captured at access/copy timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Access Context.meta twice and mutate one reference.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: meta returns a detached copy; is-identity fails and mutations are invisible.

discriminating_observation.description:
from click import Context, Command
cmd=Command('probe')
ctx=Context(cmd)
m1=ctx.meta
m2=ctx.meta
print('meta_identity', m1 is m2, m1 is ctx.meta)
assert m1 is m2 and m1 is ctx.meta
m1['f2key']='f2val'
print('meta_shared_visible', ctx.meta.get('f2key'), m2.get('f2key'))
assert ctx.meta.get('f2key')=='f2val'
assert m2.get('f2key')=='f2val'
assert ctx.meta is m1
print('meta_shared_ownership', True)

triple.is_identity: m1 is m2 and m1 is ctx.meta
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: m1['f2key']='f2val' visible via ctx.meta and m2
